def evictable(self, mid, keep):
        """A previous current bank with no open epoch reference can go."""
        return mid is not None and mid != keep and self.refs.get(mid, 0) == 0

    # -- operations ---------------------------------------------------------
    def install(self, mid, at):
        model = self.models[mid]
        mode = model['mode']
        pool = 'range' if mode == 'range' else 'exact'
        entries = model['entries']
        previous = self.current
        evict = previous if self.evictable(previous, mid) else None
        status = 'ok'
        if entries > self.capacity[pool]:
            status = 'oversize'
        else:
            prospective = set(self.resident)
            if evict is not None:
                prospective.discard(evict)
            prospective.add(mid)
            used = self.usage_of(prospective)
            if used['range'] > self.capacity['range'] or used['exact'] > self.capacity['exact']:
                status = 'busy'
        if status == 'ok':
            if evict is not None:
                self.resident.discard(evict)
            self.resident.add(mid)
            self.current = mid
        self.installs.append({'at': at, 'id': mid, 'status': status,
                              'resident': sorted(self.resident), 'used': self.usage()})
